description: This file defines the ImportListView class responsible for rendering a paginated list view of imported data in the SuiteCRM application. It manages data loading, pagination, and display logic using the Smarty templating engine.

classes.name: ImportListView
classes.description: A class that provides the functionality to display a paginated list of data during import operations, utilizing Smarty templates for rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the list view with a data source, parameters, and optional table identifier, setting up pagination and data set.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the list view as a table, either returning the HTML content or directly outputting it.

methods.name: getMaxColumnsForDataSet
methods.description: Determines the maximum number of columns among the loaded data rows for display purposes.

methods.name: generatePaginationData
methods.description: Creates the pagination data structure used for navigating through pages of data.
